title: Dismounted

inlines.v: DISMOUNTED, participle passive 1. Thrown from a horse, or from an elevation; unhorsed, or removed from horses by order; as dismounted troops. Applied to horses, it signifies unfit for service. 2. Thrown or removed from carriages.
